help.title: Search fast. Build locally. Keep control.
help.findCards1: Use Crypt or Library search for detailed V5-only filters. Select a result to open its full card page.
help.findCards2: Press Command-K on macOS or Control-K elsewhere to search every card by name.
help.buildDecks1: Create a local deck, add cards by name, and adjust quantities with the compact steppers.
help.buildDecks2: Import or export text lists, share a deck URL, draw test hands, compare decks, and review V5 legality.
help.offline1: The first visit downloads the V5 card database. Later searches and deck edits use browser-local SQLite.
help.offline2: Clearing this site's browser storage also removes anonymous local decks, so export important lists.
help.api1: MCP Streamable HTTP is served at /mcp; local clients can use schrecknet-server --mcp-stdio.
help.api2: Mirrored card REST endpoints live under /api/v1.

about.title: The V5 card library and deck workbench.
about.lead: SchreckNet is an independent, ground-up, offline-first application focused exclusively on VTES Fifth Edition card research and deck building. VDB is a feature and behavior reference; SchreckNet does not reuse or depend on its source code. Tournament archives, community rankings, and playtest-program features are intentionally outside its scope.
about.travel1: Card search and local decks keep working after the app and V5 database have been cached.
about.travel2: Your anonymous decks live in a separate writable SQLite database in this browser.
about.engine1: Rust domain logic runs natively on the server and as WebAssembly in the browser.
about.engine2: SQLite is the storage layer on both sides; MCP and REST share the same card services.

changelog.title: What changed in SchreckNet.
changelog.lead: Product milestones for the V5 card-research and deckbuilding workbench.

entries.title: Private playgroups & leaderboards
entries.summary: Track casual games with your regular playgroup and see a shared leaderboard — no account needed.
items: Join a group with a shareable code, log games, and track wins, VP, and archetype performance.
Join more than one group, edit or delete a logged game, and lock editing behind an optional passphrase.

entries.title: Precon quantities, done right
entries.summary: Adding a precon to your inventory now uses each card's real per-precon copy count, not a flat guess.
items: Enter how many copies of a precon you own; every card is adjusted by its own real quantity.
The precon browser also shows what you already own, sourced from your inventory.

entries.title: New look, and German
entries.summary: SchreckNet has a new bat-sigil identity, and the interface is now available in German.
items: Refreshed logo, wordmark, and tagline across the app.
Added Impressum and Datenschutzerklärung pages for German visitors.

entries.title: Search in your language
entries.summary: Crypt and Library research controls now follow the selected English, Spanish, or French interface language.
items: Localized exact, regex, semantic, set, precon, trait, and sorting controls.
Added browser coverage for both search routes in Spanish and French.

entries.title: Responsive deckbuilding
entries.summary: The complete workbench now fits compact phones without hiding core actions.
items: Validated ten primary routes at 320 px and 360 px.
Improved touch targets, Inventory layout, and the populated deck editor.

entries.title: Local inventory complete
entries.summary: Anonymous inventory works offline alongside local decks.
items: Added owned-card search filters, missing-card lists, want-list export, and proxy integration.
Kept inventory and deck data in the browser-local user database.

entries.title: Offline semantic research
entries.summary: Concept search is available without sending card text or queries to a remote model.
items: Added a checksum-pinned local model and embedded V5 vectors.
Kept browser, REST, and MCP result ranking aligned through shared Rust.
